body.interaction_rule: Neb. Rev. Stat. §§ 48-3801 to 48-3811 establish paid sick leave requirements. Applies to employers with 11 or more employees; LB 415 (2025) exempts employers with 10 or fewer employees, temporary workers, and employees under age 16.

citation.note: Pay Frequency: No state law mandates a specific pay frequency (weekly, biweekly, semi-monthly, monthly).
